title: 4.9 Days of the Week
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
goal: Recognize, hear and say the seven days of the week, ask What day is it today? and say Today is ...
grammar_function: What day is it today? Today is + day.
prerequisite: 4.6 sequencing; 4.8 study and auxiliary Do; familiar school and park contexts.
speaking_outcome: Ask What day is it today? and say all seven days in Today is ... sentences.

cards.pedagogy_note: Introduce the complete day question, including day and today, before it is assessed.
